entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Mr. Mrityunjay Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner, Mr. Sachin,
learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2 and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioner happens to be husband of the O.P. No. 2 apprehends his arrest in connection with Pothia P.S. Case No. 133 of 2023, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 342,
323, 307, 498A, 504 and 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Allegedly, the marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with O.P. No. 2, three years ago, as per the Muslim customs.

However, soon after the marriage, she was subjected to Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.64752 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 demand of dowry and on account of non fulfillment of the same, she was tortured in various ways, resulting into lodging of the present FIR.
4.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that in fact the present case has been instituted on account of certain differences and now the petitioner wants to resolve the dispute Abdul Subhan @ Subhan vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28327747/
1 and keep the O.P. No. 2, as his wife, with all dignity and honour.

entities.text: Abdul Subhan @ Subhan vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that there is a chance of settlement between the parties.

5. Learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2 also supported the aforesaid submission and he further submits that if the matter would be sent to the Mediation Centre, the matter can be amicably settled between the parties.

6. Considering the submissions made on behalf of the parties as well as O.P. No. 2 and taking note of the chance of amicable settlement, this Court thinks it apt and proper to send the matter to the Mediation Centre, Patna High Court.
7. Both the parties are, hereby, directed to appear on 14.12.2023 before the Patna High Court Mediation Centre along with a copy of this order.

On receipt thereof, after affording proper opportunity of hearing to them, efforts shall be made by the learned Mediator for a mutually acceptable settlement Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64752 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 between the parties and a report thereafter be submitted to the Court by the Patna High Court Mediation Centre.
8. It is expected that the mediation process shall be completed expeditiously.

9. List this matter on 18.12.2023 along with the report of the Patna High Court Mediation Centre.
10.
In the meantime, no coercive step shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Pothia P.S. Case No. 133 of 2023, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kishanganj.

(Harish Kumar, J) shivank/-
